capabilities: Show wareki, rokuyo, and auspicious days
Link notes and events to dates
Switch between month and year views
extras: Rokuyo and lunar-based kichijitsu are only calculated for roughly December 1899 to November 2100; outside that range they are not shown. README also promotes the author's other plugins.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar that shows Japanese public holidays, wareki, rokuyo, and auspicious days alongside daily note creation.

relations.evidence: responsive 12-month grid inspired by macOS Calendar

summary: Calendar plugin displaying Japanese public holidays, wareki, rokuyo, and auspicious days in multiple views, with daily note creation and note/event linking.
